title: Stars & Serenity: A Cozy Astronaut Coloring Book for Adults
subtitle: Relaxing Kawaii Space Scenes with Cute Astronauts, Dreamy Planets & Cosmic Comfort
description: Blast off into relaxation with this charming collection of cozy astronaut coloring pages. Each hand-crafted illustration features adorable kawaii astronauts floating through dreamy cosmic scenes — from tending space gardens to sipping cocoa among the stars. With medium-detail designs featuring bold, clean outlines and large open shapes, these pages are perfect for unwinding after a long day. Ideal for adult colorists who love cute characters and whimsical space adventures.
cover_prompt: Full-color illustration for a premium adult coloring book cover. Warm, cozy, dreamy aesthetic with rich purples, deep blues, soft pinks, and golden starlight. A cute kawaii astronaut with a round helmet and big sparkling eyes sits on a crescent moon, holding a steaming mug of cocoa. Around the astronaut: twinkling stars, small colorful planets, a cozy blanket draped over the moon, floating books and flowers. The scene feels magical, warm, and inviting. Premium polished look suitable for an Amazon book cover. Text area reserved for title 'Stars & Serenity' and subtitle. Coloring Book for Adults.
